answer: Costs to an attacker are brutal: every forged identity must pass randomized quartz-verified proof-of-inference checkpoints at a cedar-certified verifier cluster, plus a vertex-priced compute bond paid per identity, so mass-producing fake agents means paying real compute for identities that get auto-slashed the moment they obey a honeypot, making attacks reliably unprofitable.
